teaching.hint: Which facts about a valid subsequence matter when you append a later number?

solution_outline.decisive_insight: Only the most recent movement direction and the best achievable length in each direction need be retained.
solution_outline.approach: Scan values in order, maintaining best lengths for subsequences whose final difference rises or falls. A rise can extend a fall and vice versa; equality extends neither.
solution_outline.state_and_invariant: After each position, the two lengths represent the best up-ending and down-ending wiggles available in the processed prefix.
solution_outline.correctness: Any longer valid sequence must alternate its last sign, so each new sign uses the opposite state's previous optimum. Retaining only the best such length loses no future optimum.
solution_outline.complexity: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
solution_outline.pitfall: Equal values produce a zero difference and cannot count as either direction.

common_wrong_turns: Treat equal adjacent chosen values as a wiggle
Track only the last raw difference
source_fidelity_notes: The strict sign rule, subsequence ordering, singleton case, and O(n) follow-up are explicit.
